note: Glacier cascaded sun shadow gates. Written before the trial. Not relaxed after the pictures come back.
accounting: Colour draws stay 9. The shadow depth pass is 5 draws (world, icicle, chunk, drift, sun-facing Bolt card). Both cascades are instances of those draws, so the cascade count does not add a draw. 5 is inside the 12-draw ceiling. Unique triangles stay 195634. The shadow pass re-rasterises those meshes and that fill is reported separately. Polygon depth bias is 0. The receiver uses a normal-offset bias. The grade pass stays outside the list.
iou: On snow vertices within 70 m, binary IoU of the rendered shadow mask against a CPU light-space depth raster of fall, arch, icicle, wall, and mountain triangles projected along the sun. Threshold 0.80.
edgeShimmer: World-space snow samples in the near cascade. Two cameras about 1 cm apart that share the snapped cascade centre. Edge samples have 0.05 < shadow < 0.95. The fraction whose shadow changes by more than 0.1 must be <= 0.005.
seam: Mean absolute beauty luma of snow pairs that straddle the cascade blend (far-weight < 0.15 vs > 0.85, within 16 px). Limit 0.03.
snowBlue: On sun-facing snow (ndl > 0.4), mean (b-r) where shadow < 0.35 exceeds mean (b-r) where shadow > 0.85 by more than 0.03.
hooks: csmoff=1 and lmask=shadow are capture-only. Absent, they do not change the image.
tonemap: tonemap-limits.json is unchanged. A check run 32 passed must still pass. A run 32 miss must not get worse.
